node.statement: Take a smooth local chart theta of breve-calU at breve-e with theta(breve-e)=0, write b=theta o breve-sigma o theta^{-1}, and L=Db(0). The estimate ||L+I||<1 makes T:=I-L=2I-(L+I) invertible by the Neumann series. For q(x):=x-b(x), Dq(0)=T; continuity of Dq permits a ball B_rho(0) on which ||T^{-1}Dq(x)-I||<=c<1. Apply lem-stage1-quantitative-inverse-function with V=T: q is injective on this ball. Since sigma(J)=J gives q(0)=0, zero is the only zero of q there, equivalently breve-e is the only fixed point of breve-sigma in the corresponding neighborhood.
